# gW

> Configurable local agent supervision. Current runtime: gW 0.8.0; optional independent gw-knowledge 0.3.0. Read the implemented contract, not an earlier design sketch.

## Start and scope

- [README](README.md): installation first, motivation, implemented capabilities, limits, suitability.
- [Handbook](docs/README.md): human-readable map of all documentation.
- [Getting started](docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): isolated trial, native denial canary, update and removal.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): supervisor/worker/executor boundaries and actual event processing.
- [Security](SECURITY.md): cooperative-user threat model; no vendor-policy or permission bypass.

## Configure and integrate

- [Decision setup](docs/DECISION_SETUP.md): supervisor classifier, not the worker registry.
- [Setup skill](skills/gw-setup/SKILL.md): operator-approved backend onboarding; never retrieve raw secrets.
- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md): JSON, precedence, locks, goals, missing-evidence behavior.
- [CLI](docs/CLI.md): commands, side effects and exit semantics.
- [API](docs/API.md): exact event/model/knowledge envelopes; verdicts are not executable capabilities.
- [Adapters](docs/ADAPTERS.md): supported native subset, approval/advice differences, verification.
- [Models](docs/MODELS.md): operation/modality-based plans; no implicit native executor launch.
- [Proxy](docs/PROXY.md): LiteLLM integration, correlation, transformations and streaming limits.
- [Extensions](docs/EXTENSIONS.md): replaceable provider/authority/executor contracts.

## Knowledge

- [GW knowledge guide](docs/KNOWLEDGE.md): opt-in explicit source ingestion and context caching.
- [Standalone package](packages/gw-knowledge/README.md): independent installation and use.
- [Knowledge contract](packages/gw-knowledge/ADAPTERS.md): capabilities/revision/search/read, optional writes, MCP/HTTP.

## Examples and evidence

- [Examples](examples/README.md): temporary-state, no-key demonstrations and tested policy fragments.
- [Recipes](docs/RECIPES.md): examples and counterexamples.
- [FAQ](docs/FAQ.md): direct behavior and scope answers.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): diagnose the failed layer.
- [Validation](docs/VALIDATION.md): implementation evidence; not model efficacy.
- [Benchmarks](docs/BENCHMARKS.md): no published gW performance results; proposed evaluation protocol.
- [References](docs/REFERENCES.md): annotated primary technologies, standards and research.
- [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md): explicitly unimplemented future work.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): tests, documentation and evidence requirements.

## Agent operation and context

- [Agent interface](docs/AGENT_INTERFACE.md): native MCP, setup plans, dashboard and run tools.
- [Decision cascades](docs/DECISION_CASCADES.md): bounded primary/fallback and managed endpoints.
- [Context compiler](docs/CONTEXT_COMPILER.md): exact source assembly, required retention and delivery.

## Independent context

- [Context package](packages/gw-context/README.md): no knowledge/harness dependency; included with agent tools.
- [Context source contract](packages/gw-context/ADAPTERS.md): installed, scoped evidence adapters; not host authority.

## Runtime composition

[Plugin architecture and public contracts](docs/PLUGINS.md) · [Reference bundle](packages/gw-builtin/README.md) · [Complete extension](examples/runtime-plugin/README.md)
